review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer, Storage
review_candidates.description: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. Airbnb's Online Data organization gives every engineer at Airbnb the power to build real-time data experiences — through simple, intuitive tools, without needing deep database expertise. Within Online Data, the Storage Foundation team owns the online serving stores and databases that power Airbnb. We build and operate Airbnb's source-of-truth database: an open-source, distributed NewSQL system running on stateful Kubernetes. It stores critical data — users, listings, and more — and handles over half of all of Airbnb's online OLTP traffic. Our charter: keep this database reliable, secure, scalable, fast, correct, well-tested, and cost-efficient — at Airbnb's scale. The Community You Will Join We're hiring two roles within the Database team. Both are described below. Database Performance & Reliability: Dig into the internals of a large-scale, multi-tenant, distributed database — storage, query execution, consensus, change data capture, and shard routing and management. You'll root-cause hard performance, reliability, and stability issues, and partner directly with our open-source database vendor to land fixes upstream. Database Quality & Automation: Build the testing and quality infrastructure that lets us move fast with confidence on an open-source database. You'll bring tools like Jepsen and other database benchmarks into Airbnb's in-house testing stack, drive CI integration with OSS test suites, and design creative solutions for database tiering and representative load shadowing. As AI accelerates development speed and our availability bar climbs toward 99.99%, this role becomes only more critical to how fast and safely we can ship. Examples of the Difference You'll Make Build the frameworks and tooling around monitoring, observability, permissions, and service discovery integration. Dig into the query and storage layers to explain latency differences between B-tree and LSM-based storage engines. Design and implement traffic prioritization at the storage layer for connection pooling, CPU prioritization, and reason about traffic Test, validate and safely roll out a new CDC architecture while guaranteeing full transactional correctness across shards. Your Expertise 5+ years building and operating large-scale, Tier 0 distributed systems. Hands-on experience with database or storage internals: query execution, storage engines, replication, consensus and testing. Ability to own and dive deeply into a complex codebase, ideally an open-source one. Experience developing code, maintaining, analyzing, and debugging high-severity production incidents, leveraging AI agents. Strong collaboration and communication skills in a remote working environment. Strong ownership and a consistent track record of delivery. Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process. We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application. Equal Employment Opportunity Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. How We'll Take Care Of You Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits. Pay Range $196,000—$230,000 USD Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role. A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

review_candidates.title: Java Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Overview Join Our European Application Development Team We're excited to be recruiting for a Java Software Engineer to join our European Application Development team. This role plays a key role in developing, supporting and enhancing business-critical applications used across Enterprise Mobility's European operations. Working as part of a multinational technology team, you'll help deliver high-quality software solutions while supporting existing applications that underpin key business processes across Europe. The role reports to a UK-based manager and offers the opportunity to contribute to both project delivery and operational excellence. About Enterprise Mobility We’re Enterprise Mobility. A family-owned, global mobility leader with a $39 billion turnover, nearly 90,000 team members, and operations in 95 countries. Led by CEO Chrissy Taylor, the third generation of the Taylor family, we’re built on a legacy that gives us the stability to focus on the long-term success of our people, our customers and our business. From a fleet of seven cars, more than six decades ago, to a global network serving consumers, businesses and governments, Enterprise Mobility is a leading provider of mobility solutions including car rental, fleet management, flexible vehicle-hire, luxury rental, technology solutions and more, to help make travel easier and more convenient. Working Arrangements Our primary office location is Egham, Surrey. This role is predominantly remote. Occasional attendance at the Egham office may be required for team meetings, collaboration sessions or business needs. This is anticipated to be fewer than 10 times per year. At all other times, employees may work remotely or from the office as they choose. Why Join Us? Be part of a global leader with a strong local presence. Work in a supportive, inclusive environment that values your growth. Enjoy flexible working and a collaborative culture. Make a real impact on our business success and your career trajectory. Comprehensive Benefits – Including pension, life assurance, access to same day virtual private GP appointments & more! Employee Perks – Discounts on car hire, Cycle to Work scheme, paid volunteer days. Additional Information Salary : Competitive Hours: 40 per week Please let us know about any accommodations you may need to participate in the recruitment process. Please note that all applicants must have the ability to pass a security check involving financial probity and basic criminality. Responsibilities Develop, enhance, support and maintain Java-based business applications. Gain a strong understanding of the existing application landscape and associated business processes. Analyse requirements and provide development estimates for projects and enhancements. Design and build robust software solutions that meet business and technical requirements. Create and present technical design proposals to architects, stakeholders and management teams. Investigate and resolve production issues in collaboration with support and development teams. Work closely with colleagues across Europe and the US on requirements gathering, development and testing activities. Contribute to automation and continuous improvement initiatives that improve reliability, efficiency and maintainability. Create and maintain technical documentation for existing and new applications. Manage workload independently while delivering against agreed priorities and deadlines. Incorporate security and compliance considerations into all development activities. Qualifications Essential Skills and Experience: Experience using standard Java development tools such as IntelliJ, Azure DevOps / Git, Mavern, Azure and SQL Server Experience with technologies such as Java 8/11/17+, Servlets, JSP, XML, SOAP, RESTful services, JSON Experience of QA practices such as Unit Testing, Peer Testing, Defect fixing and tracking to resolution. Desirable Skills & Experience React development experience. Azure and Azure DevOps exposure. Experience supporting legacy Java technologies such as Apache Struts, JSP, Servlets and SOAP services. Experience working within Agile delivery teams. In addition to technical capability, we're looking for someone who demonstrates: Strong problem-solving skills. A proactive and delivery-focused approach. The ability to work independently and collaboratively. Excellent attention to detail. A commitment to producing high-quality, maintainable software. A continuous improvement mindset. The ability to balance project work with operational support responsibilities.

review_candidates.title: Embedded Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: About FOSSA Systems FOSSA Systems is a leading space engineering and telecommunications company with +50 employees, specializing in developing and deploying IoT satellite solutions for remote asset management. Leveraging advanced miniaturization and mass production techniques, FOSSA has launched +25 satellites and is actively deploying a groundbreaking satellite constellation to deliver cost-effective, cutting-edge connectivity solutions. With headquarters in Madrid and an R&D center in Lisbon, FOSSA Systems is at the forefront of innovation in satellite manufacturing, operations, and IoT connectivity. Who are we looking for? FOSSA is actively looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to join our software department in our Madrid office. As an embedded engineer you will be able to program different devices across all FOSSA engineering segments (Space, Ground, User). With special focus in the continuous development of FOSSA flight assets, comprising its ground stations for satellite control and its IoT devices. Responsibilities: Design and implement firmware for embedded devices and systems, from requirements to production and commercial deployment. Closely working with hardware and other departments to design and build unit firmware and high-level satellite applications. Support the definition of satellite and other systems architecture. Work on digital and analog embedded hardware. Prepare and maintain software detailed design and implementation documentation in accordance with company and industry standards. Profile: Telecommunications or Electronics Engineering degree or similar. 3 to 5 years of minimum related experience. Experience with C, C++ and Python low-level programming languages. Familiarity with debugging embedded systems (STM32, Raspberry Pi, ESP32, etc.). Basic understanding of circuit schematics and layouts. Familiarity with communication protocols (CAN, I2C, SPI, UART, SPW, etc.). Full professional proficiency in English. Preferably: Educational master level. Demonstrable interest in the space sector. Experience developing embedded software in Linux environment. Experience working with digital HW (programmers, JTAG, oscilloscope, etc.). Experience with real-time operating systems (preferably FreeRTOS). Strong skills optimizing and unit testing. Experience on Xilinx FPGAs. Why FOSSA? Be part of a pioneering company transforming the satellite IoT connectivity landscape. Work with cutting-edge technology in a fast-paced, innovative environment. Flexible working arrangements with a strong focus on work-life balance. FOSSA is a fast growing, revolutionary and dynamic company that works every day to find the latest technology on the market and make wonderful and functional things with it. We trust each and every one of our employees and give them the space to contribute ideas, to grow, to investigate, to try and learn from their mistakes. We are a company that believes in equal opportunities, all applications will be considered and no discrimination for any reason will be tolerated. Location: Madrid, Metropolitan area. Full Time, Indefinite contract.
